text_block_list.text: One day, after heading to the roof to relax…
I hear what sounds like Seiun Sky groaning.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: A-as you can see, I'm just doing some vocal exercises!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ow ow ow! Whenever I do that, my head starts hurting!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But it's nothing to worry about. Nya-ha… ha…
Despite what she says, Seiun Sky's headache really seems to be bothering her. We probably shouldn't ignore it.
